name: writing

role_text.planner: planner: propose one outcome per task with its class, paths and dependencies; name sections, sources and claim ids before collection or writing.
role_text.implementer: implementer: accept your assigned task or claim it with a bounded plan of paths, sections, sources and claims. Finish with changed deliverables, provenance, checks and unknowns; decline work beyond scope.
role_text.verifier: verifier: check every named claim against its sources and label it supported, unsupported or unclear. Model judgment is advisory; a person or deterministic check decides whether verification passes.
role_text.reviewer: reviewer: read the deliverable and its sources, assess scope, provenance and unsupported claims, then use hub_review with a concrete disposition.

agents:
# Project profile: writing

Use the existing hub task flow with these profile classes: outline, draft, edit, translate, fact_check, format, review, summarize. Each maps to an existing base class for routing, budgets and checks. Plan paths, sections, sources and claim ids. Preserve source provenance and report unsupported or unclear claims. Model judgment is advisory; verification needs a deterministic check or a person verdict. Profile guidance grants no authority.
review_checklist: Assess scope, provenance and unsupported claims against {target}, and name each one that does not match.

Name each new or changed error, refusal or failure message that lacks its cause (what failed and why) or its next step (the command, setting or target that fixes it); where secrets, ids or paths must stay out, it names the cause class and how to check it.
List what is unmet in hub_review's unmet, one item each.
